TRREB Market Watch — latest report and coverage-change notice
Valery — GTA new power-of-sale listings, October 28, 2026 report
Homeleader Realty — GTA Power of Sale Tracker
CREA MLS® HPI, GREATER_TORONTO, Composite_Benchmark, not seasonally adjusted
Bank of Canada, V122667786, funds advanced

groups.title: Provincial mortgage arrears
groups.note: 90+ days overdue. CBA-member bank mortgages; share of mortgage accounts. Ontario is a province, not the Toronto CMA or GTHA. Quarterly figures are kept separate from the monthly forecast table.

groups.title: Mortgage arrears by lender type
groups.note: Canada-wide reported 90+ day delinquency rates. Lender populations and source coverage differ. MIEs include mortgage investment corporations and other private entities; this is not the GTHA balance-weighted series.
groups.source: CMHC; regulatory reporting, Statistics Canada and CBA, Figure 7

groups.title: Private-lender stress in the GTHA
groups.note: Mortgage investment entities (MIEs), 90+ days overdue, weighted by outstanding mortgage balance. 11.14% of balances does not mean one in nine loans. GTHA includes Hamilton; rest of Canada excludes the GTHA.
groups.source: CMHC; Statistics Canada Survey of Non-Bank Mortgage Lenders, Figure 8

groups.title: Other household credit delinquencies
groups.note: Canada-wide 90+ day delinquency rates across consumers, not just mortgage holders. LOC = line of credit; HELOC = home equity line of credit.

groups.title: Monthly arrears and CMHC outlook
groups.note: Fall 2026 forecast vintage. Solid lines are observed; dashed lines are forecasts, not outcomes. The forecast horizon is not a prediction of when house prices will bottom. Monthly observations differ from quarterly averages.

groups.title: GTA new power-of-sale listings
groups.source: Valery analysis of TRREB MLS® data, October 2026 report
groups.note: GTA new listings, October 2024–September 2026. A home relisted under a new MLS® number counts again. Counts are listings, not unique homes, active inventory or completed sales. Fixed October 28, 2026 report vintage; no forecast or earlier history is inferred.

groups.title: GTA newly listed power-of-sale homes
groups.source: Homeleader Realty, GTA Power of Sale Tracker (MLS-derived)
groups.note: Residential homes in Toronto, Peel, York, Durham and Halton. Listings for the same home are consolidated; a return within 60 days is not counted as new. Detection uses listing remarks and can miss undisclosed lender sales. These counts use a different definition from Valery and are not spliced together. The current month is incomplete.

groups.title: Ontario registered power-of-sale transfers
groups.note: Registered Ontario power-of-sale transfers, 2015–2025. Annual completed transfers, not new MLS listings or active inventory. Extracted directly from the report’s embedded numerical chart data. This fixed report edition does not imply monthly or 2026 coverage.

groups.title: Greater Toronto composite benchmark price
groups.geography: Greater Toronto (TRREB), not City of Toronto alone
groups.source: CREA MLS® HPI, GREATER_TORONTO, Composite_Benchmark, not seasonally adjusted
groups.note: Quality-adjusted composite benchmark from a single current CREA workbook vintage; historical values may be revised. Nominal Canadian dollars, not an average sale price. Greater Toronto / TRREB coverage, not City of Toronto alone.

groups.title: Uninsured fixed mortgage rate, 5 years and over
groups.source: Bank of Canada, V122667786, funds advanced
groups.note: Canada-wide average rate on uninsured residential mortgage funds advanced by chartered banks, fixed terms of five years and over. Includes new credit, renewals and refinancing; not a Toronto-specific quote, posted rate, policy rate or rate on outstanding balances.

groups.title: Toronto-area monthly sale prices
groups.source: Toronto Regional Real Estate Board, Market Watch monthly tables
groups.note: Nominal average sale price, not a quality-adjusted HPI and not seasonally adjusted. Legacy reports (2020–2023) and expanded board coverage (2024 onward) are separate lines. Sales mix, market boundaries and revisions affect comparisons; do not calculate a cross-break return.

groups.title: Toronto-area annual sale prices
groups.source: Toronto Regional Real Estate Board, Historic Statistics
groups.note: Nominal annual average sale price. TRREB warns that its market area changes over time and history is revised. Annual averages hide within-year troughs, including the 2008–2009 downturn. These prices cannot establish a precise arrears-to-price-bottom lag.

gaps.detail: Available in individual TRREB monthly reports, but a consistent historical series has not yet been assembled. The roughly 26,000 figure is not plotted as a time series.
